item.name: lantern-sky
item.summary: background: Night sky of paper lanterns rising at different depths; the pointer is a warm breeze (canvas 2D, server-safe, reduced motion -> still sky)

useWhen: A calm closing section, a sign-up or thank-you screen
Behind a short headline and one call to action
avoidWhen: Behind long text (it moves for as long as it is on screen)
Two animated backgrounds on one page

alternatives.name: particle-field
alternatives.when: When a WebGL background fits better (many more points, GPU)

tiers.0: One still frame of the sky (reduced motion, Save-Data, no WebGL2)
tiers.2: Animated at DPR <= 1.5 with 60 % of the lanterns
tiers.3: Animated at DPR <= 2 with every lantern

reducedMotion.description: One still frame of the sky with its lanterns; nothing moves and no pause button is needed.

input.pointer: Moving through the sky pushes nearby lanterns aside and lights unlit ones

a11y.notes: The canvas is aria-hidden; your children stay real content above it on a dark ground. The sky moves while it is visible, so a visible Pause / Play button is built in (showPauseButton) and the runtime's pauseAll stops it too.

props.name: palette
props.effect: Colours of the effect (DESIGN.md A8). custom reads --fb-heat-0..4 from the page.

props.name: paused
props.effect: Universal pause prop: the effect stops drawing; the control keeps working.

props.name: maxTier
props.effect: Hard ceiling on the capability tier.

props.name: nonce
props.effect: CSP nonce for the component's <style> element.

props.name: style
props.effect: Inline styles on the root, merged after the palette variables.

mistakes: Keep the content short and on the left or centre; the sky is the point.
Do not hide the pause button unless the page has its own pause for all motion.
One per page: it runs for as long as it is visible.
verify: Server HTML shows the content on a dark gradient.
The Pause button stops the sky (no frames) and Play resumes it.
With reduced motion one still frame is drawn and nothing runs.
